dataQuery.sqlStatement: SELECT haou.attribute20 LOGO, hla.Description NOM_SOCIETE, hla.Address_Line_1 ADDRESSE1, hla.Address_Line_2 ADDRESSE2, hla.Address_Line_3 ADDRESSE3, hla.Postal_Code || ' ' || hla.Town_Or_City CP_VILLE, dst.Customer_Name NOM_CLIENT, dst.Counterpartyaddress1 ADDRESSECLI1, dst.Counterpartyaddress2 ADDRESSECLI2, dst.Counterpartyaddress3 ADDRESSECLI3, dst.Counterpartyaddress4 ADDRESSECLI4, dst.Counterpartyzip || ' ' || dst.Counterpartycity CP_CITY, to_char(SYSDATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') DATEJ, dst.cptysecondaryaccountnumber IBAN_CLIENT, to_char(dst.TRANSACTIONDATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') DATE_ECHEANCE, fvl.DESCRIPTION INFO_COMPLEMENTAIRES, --EDB381 dst.Sepacreditorschemeid ICS, dst.Sepamandateid RUM from dka_sarautoprelev_tmp dst, hr_all_organization_units haou, hr_locations_all hla, FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL fvl --EDB381 where 1 = 1 and fvl.flex_value = dst.region --EDB381 and fvl.DESCRIPTION like '%@%' --EDB381 and (('' IS NULL) OR (structured_hierarchy_level IN (SELECT hierarchy_id FROM fnd_flex_hierarchies_vl h WHERE h.flex_value_set_id = fvl.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID AND h.hierarchy_name LIKE ''))) --EDB381 and dst.org_id = haou.organization_id and haou.location_id = hla.location_id and fvl.flex_value = dst.region and dst.cashreceiptid = :P_CASH_RECEIPT_ID

SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(hou.name, 1, 3) region, arca.cash_receipt_id,
SUBSTR(hou.name, 4, 4) societe,
DECODE( NVL(rctta.type, 'NA'), 'INV', 'Facture', 'CM', 'Avoir', al.meaning --EBB 381 SHO ) AS type_piece,
DECODE( NVL(rctta.type, 'NA'), 'INV', rcta.trx_number, 'CM', rcta.trx_number, arca2.receipt_number --EBB 381 SHO ) AS num_piece,--EBB 381 SHO rcta.PURCHASE_ORDER bon_commande,
DECODE( NVL(rctta.type, 'NA'), 'INV',TO_CHAR(rcta.TRX_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'CM', TO_CHAR(rcta.TRX_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), TO_CHAR(arca2.RECEIPT_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') --EBB 381 SHO ) AS date_piece,--EBB 381 SHO TO_CHAR(ps.DUE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') echeance, case when ps.amount_due_original < 0 then TO_CHAR (ps.amount_due_original,'fm999G999G999G990D00','NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS='', ''') when ps.amount_due_original BETWEEN 0 AND 1 then '0' || TO_CHAR(ps.amount_due_original,'fm999G999G999D00','NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS = '', ''') else TO_CHAR(ps.amount_due_original,'fm999G999G999D00','NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS = '', ''') end montant_piece,--replace (ps.amount_due_original,'.',',') ARA case
when araa.amount_applied < 0 then TO_CHAR (araa.amount_applied,'fm999G999G999G990D00','NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS='', ''') when araa.amount_applied BETWEEN 0 AND 1 then '0' || TO_CHAR(araa.amount_applied,'fm999G999G999D00','NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS = '', ''') else TO_CHAR(araa.amount_applied,'fm999G999G999D00','NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS = '', ''') end montant_preleve,--replace (araa.amount_applied,'.',',') ARA case when arca.amount < 0 then TO_CHAR (arca.amount,'fm999G999G999G990D00','NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS='', ''') when arca.amount BETWEEN 0 AND 1 then '0' || TO_CHAR(arca.amount,'fm999G999G999D00','NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS = '', ''') else TO_CHAR(arca.amount,'fm999G999G999D00','NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS = '', ''') end montant_total_preleve, --ARA DECODE(arca.currency_code, 'EUR', CHR(164) , arca.currency_code) devise, to_char(arca.receipt_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') DATE_PRELEVEMNT FROM
ar_cash_receipts_all arca JOIN ar_receivable_applications_all araa ON araa.cash_receipt_id = arca.cash_receipt_id
LEFT JOIN ra_customer_trx_all rcta ON araa.APPLIED_CUSTOMER_TRX_ID = rcta.customer_trx_id LEFT JOIN ar_payment_schedules_all ps ON ps.PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID = araa.APPLIED_PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID -- left join ar_cash_receipts_all arca2 on ps.cash_receipt_id = arca2.cash_receipt_id -- BNZ JOIN hr_operating_units hou ON arca.org_id = hou.organization_id -- JOIN ar_receipt_methods arm ON arca.receipt_method_id = arm.receipt_method_id -- LEFT JOIN ra_cust_trx_types_all rctta ON rcta.cust_trx_type_id = rctta.cust_trx_type_id JOIN
AR_LOOKUPS al on al.LOOKUP_CODE = ps.CLASS -- BNZ
Join dka_sarautoprelev_tmp dst ON dst.cashreceiptid = arca.cash_receipt_id WHERE arca.status = 'APP' AND arca.type = 'CASH'
and al.lookup_TYPE='INV/CM' --EBB 381 SHO AND arca.confirmed_flag = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ar_cash_receipt_history_all acrha WHERE acrha.cash_receipt_id = arca.cash_receipt_id AND acrha.status = 'REMITTED' ) --AND araa.status = 'APP' AND arm.name = 'PRELEVT' AND araa.display='Y' ---------- -- Parametres AND arca.cash_receipt_id = :P_CASH_RECEIPT_ID
